research_question: RQ2 — Distribution-shift generalization under unseen AI generator

protocol_origin.post_rq1_implementation_detail: Macro-over-generator aggregation, result blinding, exact integrity gates, and paired bootstrap implementation are fixed here before any generator-OOD result is inspected.

primary_rq1_lineage.manifest_self_hash_note: The primary final-statistics manifest contains a stale self-reference under outputs.final_statistics_manifest.json because the manifest was included in the directory hash enumeration before it was overwritten. The authoritative whole-file SHA-256 is the external Get-FileHash value recorded here. Scientific CSV output hashes and frozen config/runner/freeze lineage remain unchanged.

split_contract.test_definition: all 300 HUMAN-AI pairs assigned to the held-out generator
split_contract.train_definition: all 1200 HUMAN-AI pairs assigned to the other four generators

training.warmup_interpretation: 10% of total optimizer steps under installed Transformers v5 API

fit_definition: 5 held-out generators x 3 seeds x 2 objectives

metrics.primary_aggregation: compute metric separately for each held-out generator, then macro-average the five generator-specific metrics within each seed
metrics.reason_not_to_make_cross_generator_raw_s: raw decision-score scales may differ across separately trained holdout models

id_to_ood_degradation.id_reference: for the same objective, seed, generator and pair subset, use the frozen primary RQ1 out-of-fold predictions where that generator was seen in training

statistics.overall_delta: for each replicate and metric, compute SupCon-minus-CE OOD delta for each generator and seed, then average across 5 generators and 3 seeds
statistics.generator_specific_delta: within each generator, average the paired SupCon-minus-CE delta across 3 seeds
statistics.robustness_delta: CE(ID-OOD degradation) - SupCon(ID-OOD degradation), averaged across generators and seeds
statistics.inference_scope: pair-sampling uncertainty conditional on the five tested generator families; not a superpopulation confidence interval over all possible future generators

pre_result_blinding.unblinding: only after 30/30 fits pass post-run pre-unblinding integrity verification
